monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral rosin-press decision system for a purchase-ready reader: it compares three exact machines, rejects unsupported tonnage and safety claims, prices the complete ownership system, and uses the return window before material contact. No merchant, model, price, rating, coupon, availability, yield, fabricated test, product image, or affiliate link was added; repair, borrowing, licensed processing, or no purchase remains valid.

image_qa.note: All three pages use original text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. No study figure, patient, cannabis product, rosin press, merchant, affiliate, stock, generated, or product image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing question.

search_console.decision: The October 19–November 15 report is three days old and valid: 830 impressions, three clicks, 0.361% CTR, and average position 20.688. Arkansas at ten impressions and position 10.2 was materially reinforced November 12; the roughly 48-impression Blue Dream family was materially reinforced November 17; sitemap-discovery parity was materially repaired and audited November 20. The remaining 510-versus-disposable and trimming-scissors rows had two impressions each, while Delaware had two impressions and one click and chronic-pain HTTP had one impression. Those signals were deliberately ignored as too weak, already served, stale-address noise, or duplicative. No new page is primarily Data-led today; analytics protected diversity and prevented another near-duplicate cluster page.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready cannabis-study reading checklist with a design map, ten-field transfer screen, result and bias checks, and printable one-study claim card using NCCIH and ClinicalTrials.gov sources. Reciprocal links strengthen the health-evidence, claim-checking, official-source, concentrate-equipment, responsible-use, clinical-handoff, and adverse-event clusters. The product-response log adds a reusable evidence-preservation asset and the editorial policy now states study-transfer and response-record boundaries. No outreach opportunity was logged and no outreach was sent; strengthening the on-site evidence system was the higher-value authority action.
